rules.name: verb + its fixed preposition
rules.one_line: The verb chooses it. You can't guess from English.

moments.said: انزعجنا من العاصفة
moments.recast: ✓ (min after annoyed, as the Doc's Emotions section says)

rules.name: kan laazem
rules.one_line: `kaan` stacked on `laazem` = had to / should have.

rules.name: chain possession
rules.one_line: Stack three or more nouns; only the last can take `el-`.

rules.name: preposition goes in front
rules.one_line: English leaves it dangling; Arabic never does.

rules.name: kaan + verb = used to / was doing
rules.one_line: kaan + a present verb: something you used to do, or were doing (past continuous).

rules.name: number + noun
rules.one_line: 2 has its own form; 3-10 take a plural; 11+ take a SINGULAR.

rules.name: make-X vs get-X
rules.one_line: Doubling the middle letter turns 'I become' into 'I make someone'.

rules.name: negative commands
rules.one_line: `ma` in front of the YOU-form. Never `la`.

rules.name: feminine -t in idafa
rules.one_line: A feminine first word grows a `-t` before the owner.

rules.name: endings on verbs
rules.one_line: The object rides on the back of the verb.
